Idempotency-Replayed.description: Present, with the value true, only when the response is a replay of the answer stored for the Idempotency-Key.

schema.description: Label metadata. Never contains the ship-to address. labelRef, trackingNumber and carrier are what vendor-connectivity returns to the vendor. A reverse label (purpose RETURN, ADR 0017) omits poNumber and assignmentId and carries returnAuthorizationId instead.

poNumber.description: Always present on an outbound label; omitted on a reverse label.

assignmentId.description: Always present on an outbound label; omitted on a reverse label.

purpose.description: Present only on a reverse label (ADR 0017).

returnAuthorizationId.description: The return authorization a reverse label belongs to (ADR 0017); omitted on an outbound label.

schema.title: Label

400.description: idempotency-key-required (the Idempotency-Key header is missing) or idempotency-key-invalid (not 1-128 printable ASCII characters).

type.description: Problem type slug, for example label-already-issued.

404.description: not-found. The addressed label or journey does not exist.

type.description: Problem type slug, for example label-already-issued.

409.description: void-after-handover (ErrVoidAfterHandover), concurrent-update (ErrConcurrentUpdate) or idempotency-key-reused (the Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request).

type.description: Problem type slug, for example label-already-issued.

422.description: validation-failed. The request is well-formed JSON but violates a value rule.

type.description: Problem type slug, for example label-already-issued.

500.description: internal-error. An unmapped failure; the detail never carries the cause. Never cached by the idempotency middleware, so the same key retries the work.

type.description: Problem type slug, for example label-already-issued.
